{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: deno

env:
  DENO_VERSION: 2.x
  DENOPS_PATH: "./"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 7 * * 0"
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  deno-lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2.0.5
        with:
          deno-version: ${{ env.DENO_VERSION }}

      - name: Check Type
        run: deno task check

      - name: Check Lint
        run: deno task lint

      - name: Check Format
        run: deno task fmt --check

  deno-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2.0.5
        with:
          deno-version: ${{ env.DENO_VERSION }}

      - name: Test
        run: deno task test
        timeout-minutes: 5

  deno-test-publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: denoland/setup-deno@v2.0.5
        with:
          deno-version: ${{ env.DENO_VERSION }}

      - name: Test Publish
        run: deno task test:publish",
  "rationale": "The repository CI history shows successful runs completing in roughly 14 seconds, satisfying the precondition for history-based/custom timeouts (representative successful-duration history). The deno-test job already bounds itself with timeout-minutes: 5, but deno-lint and deno-test-publish lack any timeout, leaving them open to runaway consumption. Adding timeout-minutes: 5 to those two jobs matches the measured P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT/P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT treatment (a timeout added to a job, with measured elapsed savings) and preserves every build/test step and all required coverage without adding privileges, secrets, publishing, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508", "experiment:batch-ishara-pattern-bat-ca499b3aaef0d029"]
}
